definition.direction: opposite candidate residual sign in follower
definition.entry_exit: candidate t+1 open to t+7 open
definition.event_schedule: exact candidate qualifying signal times before non-overlap
definition.execution: follower leg only; omit BTC hedge entirely

definition.beta_hedge: retain exact contemporaneous frozen rolling beta
definition.entry_exit: candidate t+1 open to t+7 open
definition.signal: exact candidate beta/residual/zscore computation and abs(z)>=2.0 gate

definition.reference: prior 720 fully formed follower 6h returns ending strictly before t
definition.signal_value: follower 6h close-to-close return ending at t

definition.signal: exact candidate signed-volume normalization, 4h aggregate, 90th-percentile pressure gate, 3-of-4 direction consistency and true-range guard

non_economic_diagnostics.definition: Persist that sign(close-open)*quote_volume is an OHLCV signed-body participation proxy, not authenticated aggressive order flow. This diagnostic has no P&L score and no pass/fail authority.

definition.gate: abs(4h return) >= Type-7 90th percentile of reference
definition.reference: prior 720 fully formed absolute 4h returns ending strictly before t

definition.participation_condition: mean quote volume last 8h > 0.60 * trailing-720h median hourly quote volume
definition.signal: exact candidate move gate and shock exclusion

definition.removed_condition: max true range last 8h < trailing-720h 70th percentile true range
definition.signal: exact candidate 8h move gate and low-participation gate

definition.removed_condition: mean quote volume last 8h <= 0.60 * trailing-720h median hourly quote volume
definition.retained_condition: max true range across last 8h < trailing-720h Type-7 70th percentile hourly true range
definition.signal: exact candidate abs(8h return) >= trailing-720h Type-7 80th percentile absolute 8h return

definition.removed_condition: 24h realized volatility between trailing-2160h 35th and 70th percentiles
definition.retained_condition: current quote volume between trailing-720h 40th and 90th percentiles

definition.signal: last 3 completed hourly close-to-close returns are all strictly positive or all strictly negative

definition.gate: abs(6h return) >= Type-7 90th percentile of reference
definition.reference: prior 720 fully formed absolute 6h returns ending strictly before t

definition.entry_gate: short if current close position in prior range >=0.90; long if <=0.10
definition.range: prior 48 completed hours excluding current bar
definition.retained_condition: current quote volume <= trailing-720h Type-7 60th percentile
definition.stop: next bar open after completed bar high/low breaches entry by 1.0*ATR14 against position
definition.take_profit: next bar open after completed bar close crosses frozen prior-range midpoint

one_bar_delayed_signal.entry: Shift original candidate entry by exactly one additional completed 1h bar.
one_bar_delayed_signal.exit: Preserve the candidate holding/exit semantics relative to the delayed entry; for fixed-hold candidates preserve the exact hold length, and for range-auction reversion freeze midpoint/ATR from the original signal then evaluate its existing exit rules from the delayed entry.
one_bar_delayed_signal.nonoverlap: Rebuild the schedule after the delay using the candidate same-asset/follower non-overlap rule.
one_bar_delayed_signal.signal_formation: Form the candidate signal at the original completed-bar decision time with the exact frozen candidate rules. Do not recompute the signal using the delayed bar.

randomized_timing.eligible_anchor_pool: Completed 1h decision anchors with all required PIT warmup/state available, no protected rows, and enough future bars for the template's maximum occupancy. A template must remain wholly inside the same training partition or frozen validation half as its source cluster. Original candidate signal/exposure intervals are excluded.
randomized_timing.insufficient_pool: If any source template cannot be assigned, return DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE_RANDOMIZED_PLACEBO_POOL. Never shrink the source template set, relax partition/half containment, permit overlap, or redraw.
randomized_timing.matching: Because each source independent-event cluster maps to exactly one placebo template, preserve independent-event count, constituent asset concurrency, and long/short pattern exactly rather than merely matching aggregate raw-trade frequency.
randomized_timing.outcome_blind_occupancy: Placebo allocation reserves each template's maximum possible exposure interval, not its realized outcome-dependent early exit, so non-overlap can be decided without reading placebo forward returns.
randomized_timing.scoring: After the full placebo schedule is frozen, score entry/exit prices with the candidate's exact mechanics and 24/48/72-bps economics. Outcome-dependent dynamic exits may shorten realized exposure but may not change the pre-frozen anchor assignment.
randomized_timing.selection: For each partition/validation-half independently, order source templates by source cluster entry time then stable constituent identity. Rank eligible anchors by SHA256(seed|source_template_sha256|anchor_timestamp_utc). Assign the first anchor that is unused and whose reserved maximum-exposure interval does not overlap any already assigned placebo template. No replacement and no redraw.
randomized_timing.source_unit: Use the candidate's scored Stage-1 independent-event clusters after its own per-asset/follower non-overlap. Each source cluster becomes one immutable placebo template before baseline outcomes are read.
randomized_timing.template_fields: Preserve constituent instrument set, constituent long/short direction pattern, relative signal/entry offsets inside the source cluster, fixed holding lengths, and candidate-specific leg structure. For range-auction reversion preserve the 6h maximum occupancy, midpoint/ATR definitions, and dynamic exit rules rather than its realized source exit time.

global_execution_semantics.chronology: Signal and every rolling reference use only completed bars available at decision time; entry is a future bar open exactly as specified by the control.
global_execution_semantics.cost_rule: Apply the same frozen cost rate to return on gross notional. If a control removes a hedge leg, recompute gross return on the remaining gross notional; do not grant a lower percentage cost because the control is simpler.
global_execution_semantics.independent_event_clustering: Use the same transitive overlapping-entry/exit clustering as Stage-1; overlapping asset realizations never inflate independent-event counts.
global_execution_semantics.portfolio_slot: Each admitted control trade occupies the same fixed 1/3-NAV portfolio slot as the comparable Stage-1 trade. Residual pair returns remain normalized by total pair gross notional before slot weighting.
global_execution_semantics.same_asset_nonoverlap: Apply the candidate's one-position-per-asset/follower non-overlap rule to each independently generated control schedule after all control-specific signal transformations.
